objective: Certificacion final READ_ONLY del sincronizador protegido sync_comercial_abiertas_v2. Confirmar al menos una ejecucion VENTAS_DIA posterior a 2026-09-28T21:58:15Z, idealmente mas de un ciclo, con las 5 sucursales SUCCESS/ONLINE, sin pausa administrativa ni lock atorado. No modificar codigo ni runtime. Etiqueta: Sincronizador.

queries.name: ventas_dia_post_convergence_runs
queries.sql: SELECT run_id,MIN(run_timestamp) AS inicio,MAX(run_timestamp) AS fin,COUNT(*) AS registros,SUM(CASE WHEN status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exitosos,SUM(CASE WHEN status<>'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_exitosos,COUNT(DISTINCT unidad_negocio_id) AS unidades FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE run_type='VENTAS_DIA' AND run_timestamp>'2026-09-28T21:58:15' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY fin DESC

queries.name: ventas_dia_latest_rows
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) run_id,run_timestamp,unidad_negocio_id,fecha_inicio,status,error_message,source_connection_status FROM dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE run_type='VENTAS_DIA' ORDER BY run_timestamp DESC

queries.name: ventas_dia_stale_lock
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (10) SyncRunID,SyncType,Status,StartedAtMexico,FinishedAtMexico,ErrorMessage FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones WHERE SyncType='VENTAS_DIA' AND Status='IN_PROGRESS' AND FinishedAtMexico IS NULL ORDER BY StartedAtMexico
